name: window-to-russia
description: A modern desktop application showcasing Russia's beauty through daily wallpapers
author: drbartenev-bit

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix desktop
